summary: 2 juil : Meta AI compute pivot crash semis (MU -10.6%, AMD -6.9%). Regime RISK-ON 62.2%, score 5.1. SPX 7,483 (-0.22%). KOSPI -3% overnight. NFP aujourd'hui. WTI 4-month low $67.87. 10Y 4.475%. BTC +2.6% a $60,599.

risks.label: Semiconductor crash — Meta AI compute pivot questions chip demand
risks.detail: Meta plans to sell excess AI compute, questioning the 'insatiable chip demand' thesis. MU -10.57% (vol 50.3M, 3x avg), AMD -6.89%, SNDK -10%+, XLK -2.57%. KOSPI initially -7% on SK Hynix/Samsung selling. Risk of follow-through selling if $1,000 MU support breaks.

risks.label: Yields surge ahead of NFP — 10Y at 4.475%, testing 4.50%
risks.detail: 10Y +5.7bp to 4.475%, 30Y +6.4bp to 4.966%. Market pricing strong NFP. A breach of 4.50% would pressure rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, utilities). TLT -1.04% to $85.52.

risks.label: WTI crude at 4-month low — $67.87, ceasefire risk premium unwinding
risks.detail: Oil broke below $68 support. Iran ceasefire (Qatar Day 4) draining geopolitical premium. Next support $66 (March low). Energy sector (XLE -0.56%) under pressure. Breakdown to $66 confirms full risk-premium unwind.

risks.label: Holiday-shortened week — July 4 liquidity vacuum
risks.detail: Early close Friday 1PM ET. NFP moved to today. Reduced volumes from Thursday afternoon through Monday amplify volatility. Sizing discipline critical.

risks.label: Gold weak — RSI 35, 8% below 50-day EMA
risks.detail: GLD $370.60 (+0.60%), RSI 35.3. Stabilizing after Tuesday's $4K breakdown but still 8.1% below 50-day EMA ($402.05). Next support $360 GLD / $3,900 spot. Mean-reversion bounce possible but trend bearish.

risks.label: BTC near 52W low — $60,599, structural bear market
risks.detail: Bitcoin +2.6% to $60,599 but still -52% from 52W high ($126,198). 10th session holding above $58,076 floor. Equity-crypto divergence persists. Break below $58K targets $52-55K.

events.label: NFP today 8:30AM ET — consensus 110K, range 25K-200K
events.detail: Nonfarm payrolls moved from Friday for July 4. FIFA World Cup temp jobs may push upside surprise. Strong print (>150K) = risk-on + yields higher. Weak print (<80K) = ERO risk reopens. Highest-impact event of the week.

events.label: ADP Employment + Jobless Claims — pre-NFP signals
events.detail: ADP at 8:15AM ET, Initial Claims at 8:30AM. Both provide context for NFP interpretation. Rising claims would signal labor market cooling.

events.label: Meta AI compute pivot — biggest narrative shift in H2
events.detail: Meta plans to sell excess AI compute to third parties. META +8.81% to $612.91. Semis crashed. The AI trade is being repriced — compute commoditization vs insatiable demand. Watch for follow-through.

events.label: $4 trillion M&A wave — biggest in a decade (PwC)
events.detail: PwC projects global M&A at $4T for 2026. Spin-offs (HON +64% YTD) and acquisitions flood market with new equity, reversing buyback-driven float shrinkage. Bullish for financials (XLF +2.18%).

events.label: Early close Friday 1PM ET — July 4 observed
events.detail: Half-session Friday. Markets closed Saturday. Extended weekend with thin liquidity. Any surprise produces outsized moves.

events.label: US-Iran Qatar talks Day 4 — ceasefire holding
events.detail: Ceasefire remains in place. Oil at 4-month low suggests market treating it as durable. Collapse risk = $5+ WTI spike. Fragile framework — third attempt in recent weeks.

opportunities.label: XLF — Financials rotation leader, near 52W high
opportunities.detail: XLF surged +2.18% to $54.78, just 3.2% below 52W high ($56.52). M&A wave + yield curve steepening + tech rotation = triple catalyst. PE 17.3x. Entry pullback to $54.50, R:R 1:1.8.

opportunities.label: XLV — Healthcare near 52W high, defensive rotation
opportunities.detail: XLV at $159.54, 1.1% below 52W high ($161.25). Healthcare has been stealth rotation winner. Biotech outperforming. Entry at $159, R:R 1:2.0.

opportunities.label: META — AI compute monetization, new revenue stream
opportunities.detail: Meta surged +8.81% to $612.91. Selling excess AI compute = AWS playbook. Above 50-day EMA ($606.95). Watch for consolidation above $600 for continuation entry.

opportunities.label: GLD — Mean reversion bounce, RSI 35 near oversold
opportunities.detail: GLD $370.60, RSI 35.3. Historically bounces 3-5% within 5 days when RSI <35. Entry $368, R:R 1:2.75. Contrarian play — weak NFP would be catalyst.

opportunities.label: Rotation leaders — international & gold miners lead as the dollar cracks
opportunities.detail: With DXY back below 101, EFA (ex-US) sits ~$1 from a 52-week high above all rising EMAs, and GDX jumped +4.5% reclaiming toward its EMA20. The weekly outlook favors leaning into the rotation rather than chasing the semiconductor wreck.

opportunities.label: Healthcare breakout — XLV closes at a fresh 52-week high
opportunities.detail: XLV +2.6% to a new 52-week high with RSI 72. Leadership confirmed but stretched; the higher-quality entry is a pullback toward the rising EMA20 (~$156).

regime_blips.label: RISK-ON holds at 62.2% — semis crash is sector-specific
regime_blips.detail: Regime score 5.1/100 (deep risk-on). ERO 0%, crisis 0%. The semiconductor crash is being absorbed as sector rotation, not systemic stress. Credit calm (HYG $79.59). VIX 16.45. Full sizing maintained.

regime_blips.label: Tech-to-financials rotation — XLK -2.57% vs XLF +2.18%
regime_blips.detail: 4.75pp spread in single session. Capital rotating from tech into financials and healthcare. DIA/IWM MACD bullish, SPY/QQQ MACD below signal. Rotation within risk-on, not risk-off.

regime_blips.label: Equity-crypto divergence persists but BTC shows life
regime_blips.detail: BTC +2.6% to $60,599 while SPY -0.14%. Decoupled from equity selloff for once. 10th session above $58,076 floor. Building potential base, but still -52% from highs.

regime_blips.label: Yield curve steepening — 30Y-13W spread +127bp
regime_blips.detail: Long-end rising faster than short end. 30Y +6.4bp, 13W -3.2bp. Reflects strong growth expectations + Fed hike pricing (80% Sep probability). NFP confirmation would accelerate.
